scientific_integrity: The exact Petersen bound is proved by explicit even Hamilton cycles and an antichain lower bound; a finite verifier checks local and small-instance cases, not the infinite theorem by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The bound is for noiseless strict two-stage tests with at most two identified defectives; it does not claim global optimality of t(n,2,2), classification of every optimal local pooling design, or bibliographic exhaustiveness.
title: Six even Hamilton cycles solve the Petersen strict-testing obstruction
